Your history of blisters on the forearm combined with mucosal pain (oral and genital) is highly suggestive of an autoimmune blistering disease. Given your recent medication changes, specifically starting captopril and stopping meloxicam, could you confirm if the blisters are itchy or tense, rather than easily ruptured?
